font.$description: Nine text roles. Each role has a size, line-height, weight and letter-spacing token with the role's name. Sizes are fluid: clamp() in rem from a 390px screen to a 1280px screen, so text follows the browser's font size setting and zooms to 200% (WCAG 1.4.4). Never use a size outside these roles.

display.$description: display, title, heading, subheading and card-title.
40px to 96px. The home hero only: the page's single h1. Gold italic allowed (decision 28).

title.$description: 36px to 72px. The page title of a case study: the page's single h1. Gold italic allowed (decision 28).

heading.$description: 32px to 52px. Section titles (h2). Gold italic allowed (decision 28).

subheading.$description: 22px to 30px. Subsection titles (h3), e.g. form headings. Never gold: it can be smaller than 24px (decision 28).

card-title.$description: 18px to 22px. Titles inside cards. Never gold (decision 28).

lead.$description: 15px to 18px. The intro paragraph under a page or section title.

small.$description: 13px to 14px. Secondary text: captions, meta, card descriptions.

overline.$description: 11px to 12px. Uppercase labels above a title (eyebrows). Always set in uppercase.

lead.$description: Light: the weight is what sets lead apart from body text.
